children: Apple officially launches the iPhone Duo, its long-awaited, foldable iPhone model. The device has a wide inner display, allowing the simultaneous use of multiple apps, and folds into a roughly passport-sized device with an outer screen. The model represents the company's largest change yet to its iconic line of mobile phones, and is the thinnest iPhone to date when unfolded, Apple says at its fall product showcase. The phone also features Apple's new mobile chip, the A20 Pro. "iPhone Duo brings an entirely new design while preserving everything you love and expect from the iPhone," Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, says. The phone's pricing begins at $1,999, with preorders beginning on Oct. 16.(elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
